name: Leherennus

attributes.attribute: held to be of old stock

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Leherennus was a Celtic god of the mountains. Writers regard him as pre-Celtic in origin. He was worshiped in the high country of southern France, the Pyrenees. The Romans identified him with their god of war, Mars.

okr.objective: Record the god of the high lands.
key_results: He was a Celtic god of the mountain country.
He is regarded as pre-Celtic in origin.
His worship stood in the Pyrenees of southern France.
